title: docker-compose config validator
description: Validates configuration inputs for the docker-compose skill

compose_file.description: Path to an existing docker-compose.yml to review or enhance

stack_type.description: Predefined stack template to start from

action.description: What action to perform on the Compose configuration

image.description: Docker image override (otherwise skill picks a sensible default)

build_context.description: Build context path if the service uses a Dockerfile

services.description: Services to include in the generated Compose file

environment.description: Target environment -- affects hardening, port exposure, and override files

include_dockerfile.description: Whether to generate a multi-stage Dockerfile alongside the Compose file

include_env_template.description: Whether to generate a .env template file

runtime.description: Application runtime for Dockerfile generation and healthcheck selection
